div.l: ¶ Now draw þe cut . or that we ferther twynne
Whyche that hatth þe shortest . shaƚƚ ferstferst begynne ·
Syr knyght quod he my maist̉er and my lorde
Now drawyth cut . for that is myn acorde ·
Comyth nere . qduod he . my lady prioresse ·
And ȝe ʆsir Clerk . lat be youre shamefastnesse ·
Ne studyeth noȝt . lay hond to euery man̄ ·
Anon̄ to drawyth euery wyght began̄ ·
As shortely to tellen̄ as hit was 
Were hit be auenture . or sort . or cas ·
The sotth is . the cut fylle to the knyght
Of whyche fuƚƚ blythe and glad was eủery wight .
And tellen̄ he mustehe muste as hit was reason
By forward and by composicion̄
As ȝe han̄ herd . whitt nedyth wordes mo 
And than this good man̄ saugh that it was so ·
As he that wyse was and obedient
To kepen̄ his forward by his free assent .
He seyd sithen y shaƚƚ begynne the game .
What welcome be the cut a goddes name ·
Now late vs ryde and herkenyth what I sey ·
And wyth that worde we ryden forth our͗ wey .
And he byganne with ryȝt a mery chere ·
His tale anon̄ . and seid as ȝe may here ·
Iamqꝫue domos patrias ⁊etc̉etera Post asꝑperagentis p̉relia laurig̉ero ⁊etc̉etera
Whylome as olde stories tellen̄ vs
There was a Duk that highte Theseus
Of athenes he was lord and gouernour .
And in hys tyme such a conquerour .
That gretter was neủer noon̄ vndyr the sonne .
Fuƚƚ mony a ryche contre had he wonne .
What with his wysdome and his chiualrie ·
He conquerde aƚƚ the reigne of femenye
